invariants: One native screen coordinates the document surface and shared reading controls.
One ordered collection determines the central homepage layout and entrance sequence; the policy entry occupies its own footer.
Open Document and New Document share one equal-width, equal-height native button row; Recent Documents remains a secondary text action below.
The native save dialog owns naming and location; a temporary empty seed is released with the picker, and the saved file enters the shared editor and document lifecycle.
The sheet and popover share the same list and successfully opened original-file records.
Preview, source and outline derive from one working Markdown buffer.
Preview fills the available document column with equal visible gutters to adjacent panels and no fixed maximum width; reflow preserves the reading anchor and clears the floating controls.
One window-width policy coordinates both auxiliary panels; native document controls receive the actual leading edge of the document column.
Expanded and collapsed states reuse one native toggle and reserve no document width when collapsed.
The icon-only toggle and pane are absent when the document has no outline entries; empty headings remain entries.
Automatic following scrolls only the outline pane and yields to manual outline browsing.
All rows share one leading control geometry and one layer of interaction feedback.
Both document modes reuse the same AI, mode-switch and More controls; source history actions join this group.
All window widths retain one trailing disclosure; source focus and window resizing preserve its expanded state.
The bottom group is absent while the AI panel is visible, including its closing transition; it returns collapsed afterward. Its keyboard-positioning host is removed with the group.
Expansion keeps the disclosure anchored and action slots stable; actions travel left and return along the same path while the chevron rotates continuously, including rapid reversals.
Collapsed actions neither receive touches nor appear in the accessibility tree, and their vacant slots pass document input through.
More shares SwiftUI symbol rendering and motion with adjacent actions; its transparent native button owns menu interaction only.
The fixed More menu keeps its contents stable throughout presentation; surrounding state updates must not replace an in-flight touch target.
Native keyboard geometry positions the shared group above input UI without intercepting touches outside the controls; only input covering the entire bottom edge reduces the document viewport.
System keyboard animation timing stays in charge; unanimated input-toolbar guide updates receive interruptible native layout animation, without changing keyboard geometry.
One system AI action forwards the actual selection from either document mode.
Global and selection entries share one conversation across compact and regular presentations.

One fixed, compact native header centers the localized AI Conversation title between Clear and Collapse before the conversation scroll viewport; first and subsequent user turns share the same width rule.
Both header controls use compact SF Symbols and 44pt hit targets; a smaller circular system glass surface appears only during hover, press or keyboard focus.
The side-panel collapse control shares the document close control's horizontal centerline and hit-target size; panel top and bottom margins may differ.
Outline and conversation are mutually exclusive when three readable columns do not fit; narrowing retains the last actively used panel and widening does not reopen either.
The complete panel clears local native input toolbars while the document and outline retain full height; input spacing stays inside the panel, with interruptible motion and Reduce Motion support.
One native panel owns its shell, header, composer, keyboard avoidance and presentation motion; document scrolling never projects coordinates into panel controls.
Sent turns and their reference snapshots remain immutable.
The scroll viewport keeps a small top gutter and fades its top edge only when earlier content remains above; the collapse control stays unmasked and interactive.
Following observes both content and viewport size; only navigation intent changes it, preserving manual browsing across layout changes.
Following only advances an offset behind the content end; WebKit retains control of elastic boundary rebound.
Top and bottom fades share one edge size and appear only where conversation content remains offscreen; content and viewport resizing update both edges.
One draft and its next-turn reference share the native input bridge.
The reference sits above one input capsule; native text and the native send button have separate hit regions within it.
Long drafts scroll within the native input after reaching a viewport-relative height limit, preserving readable conversation space.
TextKit measures natural input height at the panel width; the native panel constrains it to available space. Draft epochs reject obsolete text updates without replacing IME composition.
Selection references preserve the complete selected content and its enclosing semantic structure; generated math and diagrams quote their original source as semantic units.
Global AI supplies document background independently, without creating a visible document attachment.
Selection content keeps one trailing boundary outside the separate 44pt removal target; scrolling the quote does not move the removal control.
Draft references show actual selections; previously sent references remain immutable.
Each turn owns its rendered content, references, anchors and request status.
Collapsed, expanded and restored selection references share rich rendering; collapse limits visibility without flattening semantics.
Only the latest failed turn can replace its answer through an explicit retry.
Three waiting dots belong to the pending answer and retire on its first visible content; completion, failure, stop and reset remove active feedback without discarding content or drafts.
Cards represent applied document edits and their current save and history state.
Content surfaces share the parser, sanitizer and offline extensions.
CJK-friendly emphasis rules apply to documents, quotes, user messages, streaming answers and restored history through the same parser; source text and escaped/code literals remain unchanged.
Message and reference anchors are scoped to their own rendered content.

Code blocks share one floating copy control over a full-width horizontal viewport with fixed side insets. A compact round surface, derived from the icon and shared spacing, separates the control from code scrolling beneath it. Scrollable trailing space keeps line ends readable without reserving a separate control column. Single-line and multiline code retain first-line alignment, copy plain text through the native clipboard, and exclude controls from extracted quotations.

One native modal owns settings navigation and blocks the underlying reader. Complete connection settings share one Keychain record; confirmed Reset clears the saved connection immediately and uses native destructive styling.
Validation and storage errors use native alerts, preserve the draft and leave no error row in the form; Reset executes after confirmation dismissal.
Optional search is Off by default. Model and search keys share one secure-field style and Keychain record; provider keys remain separate and reset together.
Configuration resumes the original AI entry only for the same document and never submits a question.
Returning home follows successful document closure or explicit discard after a failed save.

One close control moves to the document column’s leading edge while a side conversation is open, stays distinct from outline controls, and returns to the trailing edge on collapse; its wind-up, dash and landing retarget from the current pose and respect Reduce Motion.
Retry and discard begin after the save-failure alert finishes dismissal, so an immediate repeated failure presents a new alert.
The native document model owns one working text and one undo history for typing, composition, paste, AI transactions, system editing actions and touch controls.
One quiet homepage entry presents the bundled policy with native text, lists, tables and scrolling in the App language.
The first send to each service requires explicit native approval; cancellation preserves the draft and reference without starting a request.
A tap opens the native Reference in AI Chat menu shared with text selections; long presses and secondary clicks retain WebKit image actions.
Menu references are captured once and checked against the active document token.
One conversation per document path is shared by source and preview, and survives reader closure, reopening and process death.
Only confirmed Clear History deletes turns and tool progress; it retains the unsent draft, current reference and document undo history.
Per-document conversation data takes precedence over older reader checkpoints. Restoring it does not grant preview edit access or send a request.
New reader tokens isolate asynchronous events; stable conversation and request identities prevent replay of completed document edits.
Restore the open document, one edit history, semantic reading position, annotation draft, immutable AI references and draft after process death.
Explicit successful close ends recovery; failed saves and cancelled close preserve it.
Restoration never sends a model request or silently overwrites external file changes.
Request concrete resource folders individually; do not infer a common ancestor for unrelated paths.

One native sheet separates secondary explanatory text from the primary medium-weight directory path, with Choose Folder/Cancel. Present the system picker directly from this sheet, keeping the prompt underneath; the user navigates manually, without an initial-location override.

One typed request records purpose, target directory, document token and request identity; picker results must match both identities and cover the target before persisting scope or resuming image loads or the original local document link.
A rejected selection retains the same permission prompt. Cancel resumes the current document and invalidates late results; image failures do not replace a pending document-open request.
Recent, external, in-app and session-restoration entry points reuse saved directory bookmarks while retaining the fresh incoming file URL.
Underlines and annotation text are independent states, stored locally by normalized full file path without changing Markdown.
Plain overlapping or adjacent underlines coalesce with their historical ranges; note-bearing records remain independent.
Selections use parser source positions; native manual and AI edit deltas share range transforms and one undo history.
Live and saved waves share persistent drawing layers; pointer movement does not rebuild document text.
Document copy and AI references omit annotation controls and do not implicitly include annotation text.
Creation, reading and editing share one native text card in both anchored and sheet presentations.
An anchored card scrolls with document content, preserves its initial side and retires only after its paint bounds leave the viewport.
Unsaved text, native composition and draft recovery survive unrelated layout updates; removal actions require separate destructive confirmations.
Pencil uses text-relative starting regions and spatial intent hysteresis; one recognized stroke keeps its purpose until lift.
WebKit retains native vertical and overflow scrolling, while note input retains native Scribble.

One native consent prompt shows the service and actual query or webpage URL before its first request. Remembered permission includes its data-sharing scope; a pending decision belongs to the active document and request.
